title: Scott Colom Will Be Mississippi’s Third Black Senator. Who Were the First Two?
summary: Mr. Revels took his seat two days after Mississippi was readmitted to the union after the Civil War. Mr. Bruce served just before white leaders ushered in the Jim Crow era.
